description: This bar chart, from the paper “2-Tier SimCSE Elevating BERT for Robust Sentence Embeddings,” compares the performance of five different models across three metrics: Sentiment Accuracy (light brown), STS Correlation (pinkish-red), and Paraphrase Accuracy (blue-gray), with values measured on the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy / Correlation” ranging from 0 to 0.8 in linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the five models: “Single-task_baseline,” “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout,” “Unsupervised_SimCSE,” “Supervised_SimCSE,” and “2-Tier SimCSE.” For each model, three bars are grouped side-by-side, with the light brown bar representing Sentiment Accuracy, the pinkish-red bar representing STS Correlation, and the blue-gray bar representing Paraphrase Accuracy. The bars are not sorted but presented in the order listed on the x-axis. The “Single-task_baseline” model shows the lowest performance across all metrics, with Sentiment Accuracy at approximately 0.53, STS Correlation at approximately 0.51, and Paraphrase Accuracy at approximately 0.79. The “Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout” model shows Sentiment Accuracy at approximately 0.52, STS Correlation at approximately 0.58, and Paraphrase Accuracy at approximately 0.78. The “Unsupervised_SimCSE” model shows Sentiment Accuracy at approximately 0.52, STS Correlation at approximately 0.71, and Paraphrase Accuracy at approximately 0.77. The “Supervised_SimCSE” model shows Sentiment Accuracy at approximately 0.49, STS Correlation at approximately 0.81, and Paraphrase Accuracy at approximately 0.78. The “2-Tier SimCSE” model shows Sentiment Accuracy at approximately 0.49, STS Correlation at approximately 0.81, and Paraphrase Accuracy at approximately 0.78. The chart visually emphasizes that the “2-Tier SimCSE” model achieves the highest STS Correlation and Paraphrase Accuracy, with both metrics reaching approximately 0.81, while its Sentiment Accuracy is slightly lower than that of the “Supervised_SimCSE” model.
